# The coverage pre-pass replaces html/template with muxt's template
# engine through go test -overlay. Coverage instrumentation reads the
# packages it instruments from disk and so would undo that replacement,
# which is why a -coverpkg that takes in html/template is refused before
# anything runs, whether it names the package or a pattern holding it.
# Covering your own packages is fine.

! muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1 -- -coverpkg=html/template
cmp stderr want-html-template.txt
! stdout .

! muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1 -- -coverpkg=std
cmp stderr want-std.txt
! stdout .

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- want-html-template.txt --
Error: go test flag -coverpkg cannot cover html/template ("html/template" does): muxt replaces html/template with its own template engine to learn which template actions the tests reach; use -coverpkg with your own packages, such as ./... instead
-- want-std.txt --
Error: go test flag -coverpkg cannot cover html/template ("std" does): muxt replaces html/template with its own template engine to learn which template actions the tests reach; use -coverpkg with your own packages, such as ./... instead
